## Network error and TGWS/MTProto proxy (2026-10-12)

If SETUP_BOT reports network_URLError, the Python Bot API path to api.telegram.org:443 is blocked.

- Running TgWsProxy_windows on local 127.0.0.1:1443 is not a regular HTTPS CONNECT proxy. MTProto links/tunnels for Telegram apps do NOT transparently proxy Python Bot API HTTPS requests.
- Existing 127.0.0.1:8000 and :8080 returned HTTP 404 to CONNECT; direct HTTPS timed out. No working compatible local HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy was confirmed during the audit.
- Source now supports an explicit **HTTP CONNECT** URL such as http://127.0.0.1:3128, or **SOCKS5h** such as socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080, but only when that server genuinely supports the protocol. Never assume 3128 or 1080 are running. Proxy is applied ONLY for https://api.telegram.org; Bridge loopback remains direct.
- Double-click CHECK_TELEGRAM_NETWORK.cmd to test a candidate HTTP/SOCKS5h proxy without using or revealing the BotFather token. It prompts for a proxy URL using hidden input. Status TELEGRAM_BOT_API_TRANSPORT_REACHABLE means HTTPS connection succeeded; a non-2xx HTTP status from the API root may still be fine.
- SETUP_BOT.cmd now asks for the same optional proxy URL **before** asking for your rotated Telegram bot token. Proxy and token are stored locally encrypted with Windows DPAPI once private /start pairing completes.
- For a configured Proxifier upstream, examine Profile -> Proxy Servers on your own PC and identify a **real SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT** endpoint and its credentials. Use hidden local input only. Do not paste proxy credentials, BotFather token or a Telegram MTProto secret into ChatGPT/GitHub.
- If no compatible upstream exists, use a legitimate SOCKS5/HTTPS proxy or a suitable OS-level tunnel rule for the Python executable. Do not disable security, override production proxy routes or replace the existing PC bridge.

**Verified tests:** 17/17 offline unit tests passed via PC Control request 20261012-curator-proxy-17tests-r01. This verifies code and validation, NOT a real successful proxied Telegram API request; live outbound HTTPS still needs a working compatible proxy.
